short_description: Vasculitis is inflammation of blood vessels that can cause skin rashes, red or purple spots, pain, swelling, and sometimes symptoms in other organs. It needs medical evaluation, especially if it spreads or comes with fever or pain.
common_symptoms: spots that may not fade when pressed
temporary_advice: Monitor the rash and take photos to track changes
Rest and avoid irritating the skin
Avoid scratching or injuring the skin
Seek medical advice if pain, fever, or spreading appears
avoid: Do not ignore painful purple spots
Avoid scratching or pressing the rash
Do not self-medicate with strong creams
Avoid delaying care if fever or severe pain appears
risk_notes: Vasculitis can sometimes be linked to immune or systemic problems. Skin symptoms may need medical evaluation, especially with fever, pain, spreading, or purple spots.
when_to_see_doctor: Urgently if rash appears with fever or severe pain
If there is swelling, ulcers, or wounds
If joint pain, fatigue, or other body symptoms appear
If the rash does not improve or keeps returning
